title: Straighter teeth with braces
lead: Example teeth, not yours. Fixed braces move teeth a little at a time; how long it takes depends on the person.

steps.label: Start
steps.words: Small brackets are fixed to the teeth and a thin wire joins them.

steps.label: Around month 3
steps.words: The wire is changed to a firmer one as the crowding eases.

steps.label: Around month 9
steps.words: The teeth are lining up and the gaps are closing.

steps.label: Finishing
steps.words: The braces come off once the teeth and bite are where planned.

steps.label: Retainer
steps.words: A retainer keeps the teeth in their new place.
